description: Positive-charge proton-transfer sample based on asymmetric H5O2+ endpoints.
notes: Useful as a positive-charge counterpart to Cl-_CH3F.
The gas-phase symmetric Zundel cation is a low-barrier proton-transfer system; this file uses displaced bridge-proton endpoints for testing.
Do not treat the endpoint energy difference as a physical reference without reoptimization and environment definition.
The formal charge is included in the sample name suffix and repeated in this JSON for UI validation.
